name: Icebreaker!: Friend or Froze?
source:
When Romie immigrates from the Philippines, he's not entirely thrilled with all the snow.  So  naturally, he makes up an evil monster story to stop his siblings from annoying him  to go outside. What he doesn't expect is this so called monster is real, and adorable.  Romance ensues?

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/icebreaker]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当罗米从菲律宾移民过来时，他对大雪并不感到完全兴奋。所以很自然地，他编造了一个邪恶的怪物故事来阻止他的兄弟姐妹打扰他出去。让他没想到的是，这个所谓的怪物是真实存在的，而且还很可爱。浪漫随之而来？

[来自[url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/icebreaker]Itch.io[/url]]
